characters.name: Foal
characters.description: Foal is a young horse, small size. Proportions: about 2.5 heads tall, drawn chibi. Colours: coat #b9652f, mane #f3e3c3. Signature item: white socks. Gesture: tilts its head when unsure. Must keep: white socks; nick in the left ear. Flaw: a small nick in the left ear.

characters.name: Mare
characters.description: Mare is a grown horse, large size. Proportions: about 3 heads tall, drawn chibi. Colours: coat #8d8d92, mane #2a2226. Signature item: white blaze. Gesture: lowers its head to listen. Must keep: white blaze; scar over the right eye. Flaw: a thin scar over the right eye.
